description:
High school is hard enough without a target on your back, but that’s exactly the situation Kim Yeon-Doo finds herself in when she crosses a group of the most popular kids in school. Marked by the king bee himself, the notorious Ji Hyun-ho, Annie becomes his newest fixation--and he is determined to make her life miserable. Now at his beck and call, Yeon-Doo must stay on Hyun-ho’s good side to maintain her peaceful life and avoid becoming a social pariah. As she navigates her way through alienating social cliques, persistent old crushes, and the hot upstairs neighbor who never puts a shirt on, Yeon-Doo will soon learn that there’s more to being popular than meets the eye. She just wanted to live a normal life, but maybe there’s no escaping these king bees. An official comic adaptation based on the hit dating-sim game. 

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)
